readme.text:
## SONIC MANIA ARCHIPELAGO

SETUP (assuming you already know how to install custom worlds):

Download Release.zip and extract it

Copy Data.rsdk from the root folder of your legally obtained copy of Sonic Mania Plus and put it next to RSDKv5U.exe

Edit connectioninfo.txt with the server name/port, slot name and password on separate lines, in that order.

Launch RSDKv5U.exe to connect and run the game

(playing a sound in the sound test determines which special stage you go to)

## AI Usage Disclosure
AI was used to help get things set up in the client, including some cmake stuff and debugging a bunch of dependencies, but has been rarely used after setup was done.

The main example being: Asking an LLM how to fix an error and implementing its solution if it works.

The .apworld side has no AI.
